additional_info.subject: High current/power consumption from charging stations
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
Today we received a very angry email from one of our customers for higher power consumption than what is indicated in the Datasheet for charging in Standby mode, i.e. without load/charging.
According to the Sicharge D Datasheet, the power consumption in standby mode should be approximately 260W, as indicated:
According to the Sicharge D DataSheet, the power consumption in Standby mode should be about 260Wh according to the specification:
That is, the current that should be received in this mode is 1.13A in an ideal state.
But in practice, they attach a measurement from a charging station that shows at least 10A in each phase, which is almost 10 times what is specified.
I would be happy to explain this as soon as possible, the customer is very angry, and we need to provide answers accordingly soon.
I attach pictures of the measurement; it is important to say that he checked it on all his charging stations and in all of them the consumption is the same and higher than what is specified in the Datasheet.
The customer's name is: Nofar Energy
The charging stations he owns are:
We ask for your support to provide answers as soon as possible.
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.body: I am attaching the photos to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0409429-DC/Si-D/IL-[multiple] High current/power consumption CRM:00921001582
additional_info.body:
Dear Singh,
They claim they receive a high electricity bill, so they came to a charging station to check the charging station's consumption in Standby mode. The test was done in all phases R, S, T without any load, meaning no vehicle was connected during the current measurement.
All devices were turned off, fan, heater, etc., the weather is 21 degrees continuously.
What is indicated in the 260W Datasheet refers to the situation where the converters do not work?
We need to provide them with detailed information on the subject, I would appreciate your support.
Br,
Orel.

We want to know and provide an answer to the customer accordingly. Is the self-consumption of the charging stand not in charging/load mode? Is the measurement they took of 10 amps per phase the consumption? If so, it is a lot and does not match the datasheet
Br,
